notes: ACTIVE ORDER: this is the funded S3 Canada demo (NexTech Solutions / Canadian Rangers) — a commercial demo of an S3 system, not the SBIR-funded magnetometer R&D demo. Demo unit in build for the Ottawa flight test (receive-by 2026-06-25). End customer is the Canadian Rangers; NexTech Solutions is the DoD contractor/integrator running this program. Merged duplicate 'Canadian Rangers Demo (Ottawa)' (gid 1214795652219550) into this record 2026-06-02 — same single program/order, previously split into 'Ottawa demo' and 'Arctic validation' phases. Phases: Ottawa demo flight test June–August 2026; Arctic validation Nov 2026–April 2027 in Whitehorse. NexTech evaluating S3 for tactical deployment with Joint Forces Command Canada; potential follow-on JFC procurement for the Rangers. Dan Prendergast also engaged on the Ottawa demo. Recent Slack activity 2026-06-01 confirms active engagement.
